decisions.reason: The source separately specifies 3-4 images for the stuffed dolls blog, and that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The existing publication condition already requires images and internal links before publication; specifying link destinations for the stuffed dolls blog does not change that condition.
The source specifies internal-link destinations and image count, not blog keywords or keyword replacement rules.
The source accepts the stuffed dolls blog and requests images and internal links but does not change the topic-selection workflow.
The reference to stuffed dolls is incidental to the blog being edited and does not alter the webpage replacement text.
The internal-link instruction does not change the campaign keyword count, selected replacement keyword, or mapped page.
Internal links embedded in a blog are distinct from the off-page backlink deliverable, whose count and follow percentages remain unchanged.
